text: Hitler died and went straight to hell. Then he got put on hold. He expected a throne. He got a ticket. Number nine billion and four. In front of him: Stalin, Napoleon, and the man who invented reply-all. Eighty years later, his number was finally called. The devil read his file and said: wrong floor. You're going to the basement. The basement is an eternal group project. With Stalin. And the Wi-Fi is down. Who else deserves the basement? Comment below.
